title: Microsoft 365 Family subscribers will finally be able to share AI benefits
key_facts: Microsoft will let Microsoft 365 Family and Premium subscribers share Copilot benefits and AI usage with up to five other people on a plan.
Microsoft also lets parents manage AI access for younger family members.
Individual AI feature limits will become a single AI usage allowance, and extra AI usage can be bought.
Cloud storage changes from 1 TB per person to 2 TB shared across the plan, applying after the first renewal after 2 May 2027.
The details come from an email to subscribers seen by The Verge.
Microsoft bundled AI Office features into Personal and Family plans last year but only the primary account holder could use them.
quote_evidence: Share your Copilot benefits and AI usage with other members on your plan.
The 'more flexible AI usage' change could mean that some subscribers end up paying more for AI usage, depending on how they're using Copilot.
why_it_matters_hint: Families get shared AI access, but total storage per person falls and AI costs could rise.
event_date: Email sent to subscribers; date not stated (reported 15 Oct 2026)
notes: Read GNN's copy of The Verge's report. Original Verge article not opened.
